description: Ground truth Q&A pairs for the sample OCR image pair

questions.question: What new instruments were added in the revised image?
What changed in the process values table?
questions.answer: The process values changed to 25.5 barG inlet pressure, 40.2 C inlet temperature, 89.8 barG outlet pressure, and 81.1 C outlet temperature.

questions.question: What changed in the compressor specs table?
questions.answer: The compressor speed changed to 7980 RPM and the power changed to 1.18 MW.

questions.question: What did the revision block add?
questions.answer: A revision block was added noting the CV-103 bypass loop and updated tables.
